name: Grafana
description: Query, visualize and alert on metrics from Prometheus, InfluxDB, Loki and dozens of other datasources. The observability standard.
compose:
services:
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:3000"
    environment:
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD: "${{cfg.admin_password}}"
      GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP: "false"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/lib/grafana
    restart: unless-stopped
